vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: garden
Version: 1.0.1

The OpenClaw skill 'garden' is designed to manage garden data locally within the user's `~/garden/` directory. All instructions for the AI agent, found across `SKILL.md`, `memory-template.md`, and other documentation files, consistently focus on reading from and writing to this designated local directory. The only shell commands present (`mkdir -p` and `touch` in `memory-template.md` and `SKILL.md`) are for the initial setup of this local data structure and are not indicative of malicious intent. The `SKILL.md` explicitly states that the skill does not call external APIs, collect telemetry, or read files outside `~/garden/`, and no content contradicts these claims. There is no evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, persistence mechanisms, or prompt injection attempts to subvert the agent's security or intended purpose.

llm.summary: This is an instruction-only, local garden-tracking skill that reads and writes files under ~/garden/, requests no credentials or external installs, and its requirements and behavior are coherent with its stated purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name/description match the requested behavior: the skill is a local garden memory and planner and only requires creating/using files under ~/garden/. No unrelated env vars, binaries, or services are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: All runtime instructions are local-file oriented (create ~/garden/, read/write memory.md, plants/, zones/, logs, harvests.md). The agent is instructed to parse user messages, ask follow-up questions (e.g., for photos), and append logs/diagnoses to files. This is expected for the skill's purpose, but it does grant the agent discretion to create and modify files in your home directory under ~/garden/.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec and no code files — instruction-only. Lowest-risk install model: nothing is downloaded or written by an installer beyond the files the agent will create in ~/garden/ at runtime.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill requires no environment variables, credentials, or external config paths. Its declared and actual environment access (only ~/garden/) is proportionate to a local garden tracker.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always:false and no special privileges requested. The skill will persist data in its own ~/garden/ directory as part of normal operation; it does not modify other skills or system-wide settings.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: it will create and maintain files under ~/garden/ and makes no network calls or requests for credentials. Before installing or allowing autonomous use, consider: (1) Are you comfortable the agent can read/write ~/garden/? Back up any existing ~/garden/ content you care about. (2) If you plan to upload photos, remember image data (and any embedded EXIF metadata) could be visible to the agent/session — platform image handling is separate from the skill. (3) Because this is instruction-only, inspect the templates (memory-template.md, tracking.md, etc.) so you know exactly what files and formats will be created. (4) If you share the machine or account, ensure file permissions on ~/garden/ match your privacy expectations.
